symbols.name: block base
symbols.meaning: The base $2^{4p}$ in which the coefficients of a packed polynomial are placed.

symbols.name: first coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of $J$, ranging over $0\le o<r$.
symbols.quote: Here $o$ and $\tau$ are coefficient positions, with $0\le o,\tau<r$.

symbols.name: second coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of $\Delta$, ranging over $0\le\tau<r$.
symbols.quote: Here $o$ and $\tau$ are coefficient positions, with $0\le o,\tau<r$.

symbols.name: first packed polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ whose coefficients $J_o$ are integers of absolute value at most $2^p$.
symbols.quote: Let $J=\sum_{o=0}^{r-1}J_o y^o$ denote a polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ with $|J_o|\le 2^p$

symbols.name: second packed polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ whose coefficients $\Delta_\tau$ are integers of absolute value at most $2^p$.
symbols.quote: Let $\Delta=\sum_{\tau=0}^{r-1}\Delta_\tau y^\tau$ denote a second input polynomial with $|\Delta_\tau|\le 2^p$.

symbols.name: product polynomial
symbols.meaning: The ordinary product $J\Delta$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$, whose coefficients $\Upsilon_\eta$ are recovered from one packed integer product.
symbols.quote: Write $\Upsilon=J\Delta$, and $\Upsilon_\eta$ for its coefficient of $y^\eta$, with $\eta$ running over $0,\dots,2r-2$.

symbols.name: product coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of $\Upsilon$, ranging over $0\le\eta\le 2r-2$.
symbols.quote: Write $\Upsilon=J\Delta$, and $\Upsilon_\eta$ for its coefficient of $y^\eta$, with $\eta$ running over $0,\dots,2r-2$.

symbols.name: first record
symbols.meaning: A record, a polynomial of degree less than $r$ with complex fixed-point coefficients, whose real and imaginary numerators are $a_r$ and $b_i$.
symbols.quote: A record $\Xi=2^{-p}(a_r+\sqrt{-1}\,b_i)$ has real and imaginary components $a_r,b_i\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: real numerator
symbols.meaning: The polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ holding the numerators of the real part of the first record.
symbols.quote: A record $\Xi=2^{-p}(a_r+\sqrt{-1}\,b_i)$ has real and imaginary components $a_r,b_i\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: imaginary numerator
symbols.meaning: The polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ holding the numerators of the imaginary part of the first record.
symbols.quote: A record $\Xi=2^{-p}(a_r+\sqrt{-1}\,b_i)$ has real and imaginary components $a_r,b_i\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: second record
symbols.meaning: The second record, $2^{-p}(c_r+\sqrt{-1}\,c_i)$, multiplied with the first record.

relations.quote: Signed coefficient packing computes its integer products by the [Schönhage–Strassen to Harvey–van der Hoeven multiplication](ss-hh-background.md), an ordinary subroutine call that costs $O(n\log n)$.
